text:
mira: quick sync — rolled the new pricing calculator variant to 25% of EU traffic this morning. figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/pricing-calc-eu

emily: nice. any immediate copy issues? did we update VAT language? :eyes:

zach: tracking wise — are we firing events for `calc_started`, `calc_result`, and `lead_submitted`? need those for attribution.

samir: not seeing VAT toggle in the widget preview. also rounding is weird for small numbers (0.04 tokens -> shows $0.00). can we change to at least two decimal places on output?

mira: good catch. can we do `max(0.01, round(value, 2))` for display only? internal math stays full precision.

ana: (typo) ana: re: inbound routing — if calc result > $5k/mo estimated ARR it should set hidden field `lead_tier=enterprise` and route to sales queue. ok?

emily: yes, that's the plan. we should also capture region and committed vs on-demand selection.

zach: adding `region`, `commit_type`, `estimated_arr` to events. also please confirm the experiment id so analytics can join.

mira: experiment id is `pricing_calc_eu_v2`. deploy-bot: A/B experiment created and phased rollout started (:rocket:).

deploy-bot: experiment pricing_calc_eu_v2 | cohort B = 25% EU | started 2025-11-02T09:12Z

samir: quick snippet for currency conversion i pushed to the widget branch — using daily FX rate, fallback to 1.0:
```js
function toDisplay(amountUsd, fxRate) {
  const raw = amountUsd * (fxRate || 1);
  return (Math.max(0.01, Math.round(raw * 100) / 100)).toFixed(2);
}
```

ana: can we get a short FAQ blurb to cover VAT, exchange rates, and committed discounts? marketing to provide copy, product to approve.

emily: draft FAQ proposals: 1) "Do prices include VAT?" -> explains displayed prices are pre-VAT and we show estimates. 2) "How are exchange rates handled?" -> daily rates, may vary at invoice. 3) "What is committed capacity?" -> defines discounts and minimum term.

ryan: wording note — avoid using both 'committed' and 'reserved' in the same doc. pick one tier name. testing two CTAs is fine but keep naming consistent across page and calculator.

mira: agree. for EU test we'll use 'Committed' in the calc copy and pass an alternate to see which converts.

emily: tagging cs and sales for alignment: @cs-team @sales-ops — please verify routing for enterprise leads and availability of demo slots.

zach: small ask — can we add a `calc_variant` field to events so we can trace which naming performed better?

mira: done. final checklist before we ramp to 100%: 1) add rounding fix (samir) 2) fire events (zach) 3) hidden lead field + routing (ana) 4) FAQ copy draft (emily) 5) analytics dashboard (zach) 6) legal quick review for VAT line (legal)

emily: i'll post FAQ drafts by EOD and ping legal.

ana: sales queue setup will be ready tomorrow, will confirm.

samir: i'll open a PR for the rounding fix, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pricing-widget/pull/412

mira: excellent. will sync tomorrow AM for results snapshot. :thumbsup:
